from pathlib import Path
expected = '\\''/private/var/folders/76/hd61cw513zbdlr0y7_h27dx80000gn/T/harness-smoke-0vwf4lur/C'\\''

run.mkdir()
deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
stop_signal = [None]
def stop(sig, frame):
    stop_signal[0] = sig
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
parent_pid = os.getpid()
child_pid = os.fork()
role = '\\''child'\\'' if child_pid == 0 else '\\''parent'\\''
def record(event):
    with (run / (role + '\\''-heartbeat.jsonl'\\'')).open('\\''a'\\'') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'\\''role'\\'': role, '\\''pid'\\'': os.getpid(), '\\''event'\\'': event, '\\''monotonic'\\'': time.monotonic(), '\\''signal'\\'': stop_signal[0]}) + '\\''\\n'\\'')
if child_pid "'!= 0:

record('\\''started'\\'')
while stop_signal[0] is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
    record('\\''heartbeat'\\'')
    time.sleep(0.2)
record('\\''stopped'\\'')
if child_pid == 0:
    os._exit(0)
try:
    os.kill(child_pid, signal.SIGTERM)
except ProcessLookupError:
    pass
_, child_status = os.waitpid(child_pid, 0)
